guideLines.text: Drop pieces into the box. Two identical pieces that touch merge into the next, larger piece. Two of the largest (level 11) merge and vanish.
Move the pointer over the box, or the arrow keys
Esc, or click the skill again
Pieces resting above the red dashed line start a 5-second countdown. Get them back below the line in time, or the game ends.
Bigger merges score more: 1, 3, 6, 10 … up to 66 points. New pieces come from the five smallest sizes; NEXT shows the one after the current piece. BEST keeps your highest score.
Each merge fills one SP cell; 12 cells give 1 SP, up to 3. Choose a skill, then click a piece or the box to use it.
A rising wind fills the box for a few seconds and lifts the pieces.
Shakes the box from side to side.
Pick two pieces to trade places. It charges with the SP you spend on the other skills.

guideLines.text: 将山团团投入容器。两个相同的山团团接触后，会合成更大一级的山团团。两个最大的山团团（第 11 级）合成后会消失。
在容器上移动指针，或使用方向键
按 Esc，或再次点击该技能
山团团停在红色虚线上方时，会开始 5 秒倒计时。倒计时结束前让它们回到线下，否则游戏结束。
合成的山团团越大，得分越高：1、3、6、10……最高 66 分。新的山团团来自最小的五种；NEXT 显示当前之后的一个。BEST 记录最高分。
每次合成填充一格能量，12 格积满获得 1 点 SP，最多 3 点。选择技能后，点击山团团或容器即可发动。
上升气流充满容器数秒，托起山团团。
选择两个山团团交换位置。在其他技能上消耗 SP 即可充能。
